findings.detail: Equity share and unit counts disclosed in the Principal / Shares column were not populated for the extracted equity rows.

rationale: C04 reports that 0.0% of 12 equity rows have shares, but the raw March 31, 2026 investment schedule labels the column Principal / Shares and supplies counts throughout the equity section. Table 17 row 4 discloses 13,570 Preferred Units and table 18 row 4 discloses 326 Equity Units. The schedule therefore anchors expected share coverage at 100% versus the observed 0%, proving a systematic equity share-column extraction gap.
